name: Main Hospital Entrance & Triage Desk
description: Primary patient entry with reception, wheelchair assistance, and immediate emergency triage.

name: Intensive Care Unit (ICU - Ward 4A)
description: Level-1 Critical Care Unit equipped with 24/7 intensivists, hemodynamic monitors, central oxygen, and invasive ventilators.

name: 24/7 Emergency & Trauma Bay
description: Immediate acute trauma resuscitation and ambulance intake station.

name: Central Hospital Pharmacy & Dispensary
description: 24-hour computerized pharmacy providing emergency prescription and critical care medications.

name: Radiology & MRI / CT Diagnostic Center
description: Advanced imaging suite with 3T MRI, 128-slice CT scanner, and bedside digital X-ray.

name: Clinical Pathology & Blood Bank
description: NABH-accredited blood component bank and automated diagnostic pathology lab.

name: Cardiac Care Unit (CCU & Cath Lab)
description: Specialized coronary intensive care and rapid intervention catheterization lab.

name: Stretcher & Visitor Elevators
description: High-capacity stretcher lifts connecting to Level 2 (Modular Operation Theaters) and Level 3 (Private Inpatient Wards).

name: Admissions & Insurance Desk
description: Cashless TPA insurance approvals, patient admissions, and administrative billing.

name: Doctor & Visitor Cafeteria
description: Healthy patient diet meals, warm beverages, and visitor refreshments.
